visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a vibrant, high-ceilinged modern shopping mall. A person in a large, plush brown bear mascot costume (Butter Bear) wearing a checkered headband and a white apron is dancing energetically for a massive, dense crowd. Dozens of people are holding up smartphones to record the performance. A male creator with glasses and a pink shirt is seen in the foreground, smiling broadly while looking at the camera. (2) The visual shifts to a montage of close-ups showing Butter Bear branded products. Cardboard boxes with cute bear illustrations containing donuts are stacked neatly. There are also smaller packaged snacks and bottled drinks on a shelf. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a professional retail environment. (3) The character is seen in a flashback-style sequence at a smaller, more modest outdoor-style stall. The bear is dancing in a simple white dress with a red bow. Fewer people are watching compared to the previous scene. The background shows glass windows and a more relaxed pedestrian setting. (4) The scene returns to the modern mall. The mascot is now being escorted by staff through a cheering corridor of fans. There are colorful banners and decorations hanging from the ceiling. The bear is carrying a large bouquet of flowers. The creator appears again, interacting with the mascot, high-fiving, and posing for photos with a look of extreme excitement. (5) A series of quick cuts shows various promotional collaborations and retail locations, including a duty-free shop at an airport with a large 'Butterbear' sign. The mascot is seen in different outfits, including a blue jumpsuit alongside another male figure. The creator is seen wearing a yellow 'Meet & Greet' wristband, showing it to the camera with a wide grin. (6) The final phase shows the mascot waving goodbye to a huge crowd from a stage-like area. The creator takes a selfie video with the mascot and the crowd in the background, both appearing very happy. The lighting remains vibrant with high saturation colors throughout.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 有一種勵志叫做. [Logo]: @ethan_kuan_kuan. (2) [Subtitle]: 泰國奶油小熊 Butter Bear. (3) [Subtitle]: 2024年2月 我來曼谷遊學一個月. (4) [Subtitle]: 認識了傳說中的 Butter Bear. (5) [Subtitle]: 當時的他只是一個甜點店的吉祥物. (6) [Subtitle]: 每週六會出現在 Emsphere 商場跳舞. (7) [Subtitle]: 小小的攤位連店面都沒有. (8) [Subtitle]: 誰曉得不到一年的時間已成了國際女明星. (9) [Subtitle]: 2月的時候我們第一次見面. (10) [Subtitle]: 他自己提著音響從電梯走出來. (11) [Subtitle]: 各種短影音的舞蹈都能跳. (12) [Subtitle]: 排隊拍照不用10分鐘. (13) [Subtitle]: 不過同年7月他的人氣就已經爆棚囉. (14) [Subtitle]: 出電梯就被列隊歡迎. (15) [Subtitle]: 這半年的時間他舉辦了自己的見面會. (16) [Subtitle]: 發行了單曲 連王嘉爾來曼谷開店. (17) [Subtitle]: 都要找小熊站台. (18) [Subtitle]: 店家也從攤位變成了超大商店. (19) [Subtitle]: 各個商場的展覽跟周邊一個一個開. (20) [Subtitle]: 像是 Zara 7-11 手機殼 曼谷包. (21) [Subtitle]: 就連曼谷機場也開了自己的免稅店. (22) [Subtitle]: 到了2024年12月 要提前好幾週上網搶票. (23) [Subtitle]: 不過他的親民程度絕對還是百分百啦. (24) [Subtitle]: 我很幸運搶到了名額. (25) [Subtitle]: 在拍完照之後 Butter Bear 居然還依依不捨地看著我. (26) [Subtitle]: 我終於明白為什麼這麼多女孩為他瘋狂了. (27) [Subtitle]: 人生有什麼不如意就想想 Butter Bear 吧. (28) [Subtitle]: 只要一直做著自己喜歡的事情 就會發光就會被看見. (29) [Subtitle]: 我會繼續愛你的.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy male Mandarin voiceover and a fast-tempo, upbeat electronic pop background music track. A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect marks the first scene transition. The narrator speaks with a high-arousal, joyful tone, and his speech is very continuous. (2) A subtle 'pop' sound effect occurs as text overlays appear on the screen. The music maintains a consistent 4/4 electronic beat. Distant, muffled cheering sounds from a crowd are layered underneath the main voice and music. (3) The vocal delivery becomes slightly more narrative and reflective but remains energetic. The music continues without interruption. There is a slight increase in ambient room tone as the scene moves through different mall environments. (4) Another transition sound effect accompanies a fast montage. The music's rhythm remains steady, while the narrator's volume peaks during mentions of famous celebrities. Small crowd laughter tracks are audible during the selfie interaction scenes. (5) The track concludes with the narrator's voice reaching a final high pitch of excitement. The background music maintains its intensity until a quick fade-out at the very end of the clip.
